section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, and discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which comprises a detection machine, wherein a movable cover is rotationally arranged at the rear side of the top of the detection machine, a detection groove is arranged at the top of the detection machine, a placing pipe is arranged in the detection groove, a fixed structure is arranged on the placing pipe, a pipe structure is arranged at the top of the placing pipe, when the sample adding gun stretches into the placing pipe to add liquid, the rubber sheet can provide resistance and the dead weight of the liquid in the placing pipe can enable the placing pipe to move downwards, the diversion needle punctures the soft film and stretches into the liquid placing groove to introduce the liquid into the water absorbing ring, so that the liquid is kept moist, at the moment, the sealing film can be adsorbed through the tension of the liquid on the surface of the water absorbing ring, and when the gland is opened, the sealing film cannot displace and is matched with the rubber sheet to form secondary sealing, so that aerosol and cross infection are avoided.

本发明涉及基因检测技术领域，且公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括检测机，所述检测机顶部的后侧转动设有活动盖，所述检测机的顶部开设有检测槽，所述检测槽内设有放置管，所述放置管上设有固定结构，所述放置管的顶部设有管材结构，本发明提供的用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备具有固定结构和管材结构，加样枪伸入到放置管内进行加液时橡胶片会提供阻力以及放置管内的液体的自重会让放置管向下移动让引水针刺破软膜伸入到放液槽内将液体引入吸水环内，使其保持湿润，此时封膜覆盖可以通过吸水环表面液体的张力将封膜吸附住，在压盖打开时封膜不会出现位移并配合橡胶片形成二次密封避免气溶胶和交叉感染。

Gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

In the patent application of application publication number CN216639489U, it includes the equipment body, the bottom fixedly connected with base of equipment body, the bottom fixedly connected with supporting shoe of base, the top fixedly connected with of base inner chamber adjusts the seat, the bottom of adjusting the seat is provided with the lift seat, the spacing groove has all been seted up to the both sides at lift seat top, the bottom fixedly connected with lifter block of lift seat, the bottom of lifter block runs through to the inner chamber and the fixedly connected with movable wheel of supporting shoe, the bottom of movable wheel extends to the bottom of supporting shoe, the back fixedly connected with motor of adjusting the seat, the front side fixedly connected with rotary rod of motor output, the front end of rotary rod runs through to the inner chamber of adjusting the seat and overlaps and be equipped with the cam, the both sides of cam all are provided with the movable block, and the equal fixedly connected with of one side that two movable blocks are opposite removes the frame, and two opposite one ends all run through to the outside of adjusting the seat and fixedly connected with removes the shell, the bottom fixedly connected with regulating wheel of movable shell, the bottom of regulating wheel extends to the inner chamber of spacing groove, the advantage is: through setting up the supporting shoe, can with ground contact improve equipment's stability, through setting up the removal wheel, can be convenient for the removal of whole device, through setting up the spacing groove, can be convenient for adjust the cooperation of wheel and lifting seat and use, through setting up the slide bar, can improve lifting seat's stability, through setting up spacing box, dog, pull rod and second spring, can be used for restricting lifting seat, through setting up slider and spout, can be convenient for remove the removal of shell.

In the prior art including above-mentioned patent, in the process of carrying out experimental operation to the stoste of placing in the pipe, the container opens the application of force and is hard or contaminated application of sample rifle and inhale the sample repeatedly, and the friction produces aerosol pollution in the liquid residual sleeve and places the pipe of placing of stoste and do not in time seal the membrane and cause splash, leak etc. and cause cross contamination, forms aerosol pollution or cross contamination influence experimental testing result.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to solve the problems that: the placing pipe filled with detection liquid in the gene detection equipment is easy to loosen the sealing film when the movable cover is opened and closed, so that aerosol cross infection is caused.

In order to solve the technical problems, the technical scheme of the invention is as follows: the utility model provides a gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering, includes the detection machine, the rear side rotation at detection machine top is equipped with the movable cover, the detection groove has been seted up at the top of detection machine, be equipped with the pipe of placing in the detection groove, be equipped with fixed knot on the pipe of placing, the top of placing the pipe is equipped with tubular product structure, place the pipe and use with fixed knot and tubular product structure cooperatees:

The fixed knot constructs including the fixed plate, a plurality of logical groove has been seted up at the top of fixed plate, logical groove and the outer tube wall looks adaptation of placing the pipe, the blowing groove has been seted up at the top of fixed plate and the both sides that lie in logical groove.

Preferably, the liquid is placed in the liquid placing tank, a soft film is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the liquid placing tank, and the soft film is sealed to prevent the liquid from flowing out.

Preferably, the two sides at the top of the fixing plate are fixedly provided with the supporting plates, the two sides at the bottom of the fixing plate are fixedly provided with the rubber pads, the front face of the detector is provided with the display screen, and one side of the front face of the detector is provided with the control end.

Preferably, the top of the supporting plate is rotatably provided with a gland, the front side and the rear side of the top of the other supporting plate are rotatably provided with movable buckles, and the top of the placing pipe is provided with a sealing film.

Preferably, the pipe structure comprises a top ring, the top ring is in a circular ring shape, the inner wall of the top ring is fixedly connected with the top of the outer wall of the placing pipe, an annular groove is formed in the top of the top ring, and a water absorbing ring is arranged in the annular groove.

Preferably, the front side and the rear side of the two sides of the bottom of the water absorption ring are fixedly provided with water diversion needles, and the bottom of each water diversion needle penetrates through the top ring and extends to the outside of the top ring.

Preferably, the top of the inner wall of the placing pipe is provided with rubber sheets, the rubber sheets are arranged in a petal type annular mode, the bottom of the fixing plate is provided with a connecting ring, and sleeves are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the connecting ring.

Preferably, the bottom of the sleeve is provided with a placing groove, the bottom of the placing groove is fixedly provided with a spring, the bottom of the sleeve is slidably provided with a movable rod, and the top of the movable rod is fixedly connected with the bottom of the spring.

Preferably, the bottom of the movable rod is provided with a conical seat, the top of the conical seat is provided with a conical groove, and the conical groove is matched with the bottom of the placing pipe.

Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention has the following advantages:

(1) The placing pipe is provided with a fixing structure and a pipe structure, the pipe structure is provided with a water absorption ring, a water diversion needle and a rubber sheet, when a user stretches into the placing pipe through the sample adding gun to add liquid, the rubber sheet can provide certain resistance, the self weight of the liquid in the placing pipe can enable the placing pipe to move downwards for a certain distance, the water diversion needle pierces a soft film arranged on the fixing structure to stretch into the liquid placing groove to introduce the liquid into the water absorption ring, the water absorption ring is enabled to be wet, at the moment, the sealing film can be adsorbed by the tension of the liquid on the surface of the water absorption ring, the sealing film can not displace when the gland is opened and closed, and can form secondary sealing to avoid aerosol infection and cross infection by matching with the rubber sheet, the bottom of the placing pipe is also provided with a conical seat capable of being pressed and rebounded, one conical seat can support the placing pipe when not in use, and the other conical seat can rebound to the initial position after the water diversion needle absorbs the liquid, so that the sealing is prevented from being influenced by a gap between the sealing film and the placing pipe;

(2) Be equipped with two curved liquid grooves of putting on the fixed knot and put the flexible membrane that is equipped with diversion needle bottom atress just can puncture in the cistern, the flexible membrane can seal fixed to the liquid of putting in the cistern when the fixed plate daily use, guarantees when taking the fixed plate and remove that the liquid of putting in the cistern can not spill, and the both sides of fixed plate still are equipped with the backup pad, are equipped with the gland that seals the time measuring usefulness of placing the pipe in the backup pad, and the gland can be fixed through movable buckle, and the gland takes place not hard up when avoiding removing or placing.

Detailed Description

So that the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present disclosure are more apparent, the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present disclosure will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings of the embodiments of the present disclosure. It will be apparent that the described embodiments are some, but not all, of the embodiments of the present disclosure. All other embodiments, which can be made by one of ordinary skill in the art without the need for inventive faculty, are within the scope of the present disclosure, based on the described embodiments of the present disclosure.

Unless defined otherwise, technical or scientific terms used in this disclosure should be given the ordinary meaning as understood by one of ordinary skill in the art to which this disclosure belongs. The use of the terms "comprising" or "includes" and the like in this disclosure is intended to cover an element or article listed after that term and equivalents thereof without precluding other elements or articles. The terms "connected" or "connected," and the like, are not limited to physical or mechanical connections, but may also include electrical connections, whether direct or indirect. "upper", "lower", "left", "right", etc. are used merely to indicate relative positional relationships, which may also be changed when the absolute position of the object to be described is changed.

As shown in fig. 1 to 12, the gene detection device for biological genetic engineering provided by the invention comprises a detection machine 2, wherein a movable cover 1 is rotatably arranged at the rear side of the top of the detection machine 2, a detection groove is formed in the top of the detection machine 2, a placing pipe 10 is arranged in the detection groove, a fixed structure 4 is arranged on the placing pipe 10, a pipe structure 6 is arranged at the top of the placing pipe 10, and the placing pipe 10 is matched with the fixed structure 4 and the pipe structure 6 for use:

The fixing structure 4 comprises a fixing plate 401, a plurality of through grooves 403 are formed in the top of the fixing plate 401, the through grooves 403 are matched with the outer pipe wall of the placing pipe 10, and liquid discharging grooves 402 are formed in the top of the fixing plate 401 and located on two sides of the through grooves 403.

The liquid is placed in the liquid discharge tank 402, a soft film 404 is arranged on the top of the inner wall of the liquid discharge tank 402, and the soft film 404 is sealed to prevent the liquid from flowing out.

The backup pad 11 is all fixed to both sides at fixed plate 401 top, and the both sides of fixed plate 401 bottom are all fixed and are equipped with rubber pad 12, and the front of detecting machine 2 is equipped with display screen 5, and the positive one side of detecting machine 2 is equipped with control end 7.

The top of the supporting plate 11 is rotatably provided with a gland 3, the front side and the rear side of the top of the other supporting plate 11 are rotatably provided with movable buckles 9, and the top of the placing pipe 10 is provided with a sealing film 8.

The pipe structure 6 comprises a top ring 604, the top ring 604 is in a ring shape, the inner wall of the top ring 604 is fixedly connected with the top of the outer wall of the placing pipe 10, an annular groove is formed in the top of the top ring 604, and a water absorbing ring 607 is arranged in the annular groove.

The front side and the rear side of the two sides of the bottom of the water absorption ring 607 are fixedly provided with water diversion needles 606, the bottom of the water diversion needles 606 penetrate through the top ring 604 and extend to the outside of the top ring 604, and the water diversion needles 606 are made of hard paper rods.

The top of the inner wall of the placing pipe 10 is provided with a rubber sheet 608, the rubber sheet 608 is arranged in a petal type annular shape, the bottom of the fixing plate 401 is provided with a connecting ring 605, and two sides of the bottom of the connecting ring 605 are fixedly provided with sleeves 602.

A placing groove is formed in the bottom of the sleeve 602, a spring 609 is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the placing groove, a movable rod 603 is slidably arranged at the bottom of the sleeve 602, and the top of the movable rod 603 is fixedly connected with the bottom of the spring 609.

The bottom of movable rod 603 is equipped with toper seat 601, and the conical groove has been seted up at the top of toper seat 601, and the conical groove looks adaptation of the bottom of placing pipe 10.

The working principle and the using flow of the invention are as follows: when in use, a user rotates the movable cover 1 to open, the gun head of the sample adding gun is aligned with the pipe orifice of the placing pipe 10 after opening, a certain pressing force is applied after alignment to push the gun head of the sample adding gun away from the rubber sheet 608, the gun head pushes away the rubber sheet 608, meanwhile, stock solution to be detected is injected into the placing pipe 10, the thrust of the gun head in the injection process is matched with the dead weight of the stock solution in the placing pipe 10 to drive the top ring 604 to move downwards, the placing pipe 10 moves downwards and drives the conical seat 601 to drive the movable rod 603 to move downwards along the sleeve 602 and stretch the spring 609, when the top ring 604 moves to a certain position, the soft membrane 404 is punctured, the water diversion needle 606 enters the liquid placing groove 402 after the soft membrane 404 is ruptured, the water diversion needle 606 is made of water absorption material, the water diversion needle 606 sucks the liquid in the liquid placing groove 402 upwards and sucks the water on the water diversion needle 606 by the water absorption property of the water absorption ring 607, the suction ring 607 which is dried originally becomes wet after suction, the gun head is pulled out, the rubber sheet 608 is closed to form a first seal protection preferentially, the placing pipe 10 is returned to the initial position by the resilience force of the spring 609, the sealing film 8 is covered on the top ring 604 in the later detection process, the wet top ring 604 is matched with the sealing film 8 with a flat surface to form a secondary seal between the rubber sheet 608 and the sealing film 8 by surface tension, the sealing film 8 is prevented from being moved by wind force caused by faster opening when the cover 3 is pressed again by the surface tension, aerosol infection is caused, the cover 3 is closed in a rotating mode in the final detection process, the cover 3 is fastened firmly by the movable buckle 9 after closing, the detection machine 2 can be started to detect genes of stock solution after the movable cover 1 is closed, and when the liquid to be tested is less and a lot of placing pipes 10 are not needed, the placing tube 10 can be slid out from the fixing plate 401 according to the actual use requirement, and then placed back when in use.

The above embodiments are only exemplary embodiments of the present invention and are not intended to limit the present invention, the scope of which is defined by the claims. Various modifications and equivalent arrangements of this invention will occur to those skilled in the art, and are intended to be within the spirit and scope of the invention.
